content_sections.heading: About BMC Senior Resident
content_sections.text: Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College & Dr. R. N. Cooper Municipal General Hospital is a municipal medical college and general hospital of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, located in Juhu, Mumbai 400 056. The Dean of the college and hospital has issued this notice for Senior Residents in the Radiology Department.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: There are 7 Senior Resident posts in total, all in the Radiology Department. The notice states that the number of posts is not fixed but variable, and that reservation for Backward Class will be considered. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The age limit is 38 years for Open category candidates and 43 years for Reserved category candidates. The notice does not give an "as on" date for age. Candidates holding medical qualifications must be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council and hold a valid certificate. Blacklisted candidates and candidates who have completed 8 posts will not be considered. Candidates who registered on or before 31 October 2026 and have not completed a total of 08 Resident Posts must submit an undertaking. The undertaking states that their total tenure of Resident Posts is less than 4 years. Without it, they will not be considered for a post. A candidate who does not join the post when offered, or who abandons the post before the tenure ends, is not eligible for appointment to any of the Municipal Medical Institutions for 3 years from the date of leaving the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Senior Resident (Radiology) post.

rows.qualification: Candidate must have M.D degree or D.N.B or D.M.R.E in Radiology from recognized University.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Tenure: The posts are for the tenure from 6 November 2026 to 31 January 2027. The tenure is likely to be terminated before 31 January 2027 if Bonded/DNB candidates become available. Security deposit: A selected candidate must pay Rs.10,000/- as a security deposit at the time of joining. It is paid by Demand Draft/Pay Order drawn in favour of "BrihanMumbai Municipal Corporation". No appointment order is given without it. Refund and forfeiture: The deposit is refunded when the post is completed, after recovery of any dues. It is forfeited if the candidate leaves the post before completing the tenure. It is also forfeited if the refund is not claimed within six months after completion. Continuing in the same institution: The deposit can be carried over if the candidate continues a tenure post in the same institution. Such candidates must produce the Original Receipt of the deposit at the time of interview. Shifts: Selected candidates must complete an 8-hour shift and work in rotation across all three shifts: 8 AM to 4 PM, 4 PM to 12 AM and 12 AM to 8 AM. Attendance: Selected candidates must mark attendance on the biometric system at both entry and exit. Emergency duty: In an emergency, candidates may be required to work as the department needs and to perform any duties the department assigns. Hostel: The warden will provide hostel accommodation if available. Resignation: Resigning with one month's notice and being relieved by the Dean is permissible. The post counts as abandoned before completion if a candidate leaves abruptly or with short notice. The same applies if a candidate is not relieved because of exigencies of service, shortage of staff and the like, and still stops attending.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The completed and signed application form. Reserved category candidates: attested copies of the Caste Certificate, Caste Validity and Non-Creamy Layer certificate (wherever applicable), attached to the application. Original certificates, brought to counselling for verification. Reserved category candidates: the original caste certificate and caste validity certificate, produced at the time of interview. Candidates who will be appointed in the same hospital where they worked in their last tenure: the original receipt of the Rs.10,000/- deposit paid earlier. Candidates who registered on or before 31 October 2026 and have not completed a total of 08 Resident Posts: an undertaking that their total tenure of Resident Posts is less than 4 years. At joining: a Demand Draft/Pay Order for Rs.10,000/- in favour of "BrihanMumbai Municipal Corporation" as the security deposit.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there in BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 Senior Resident posts in the Radiology Department: OPEN 4, SC 1, ST 1 and VJNT 1. The notice says the number of posts is not fixed but variable.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BMC Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Completed forms must be handed in by 3 November 2026, between 10.30 am and 01.30 pm or between 02.00 pm and 05.00 pm. Applications received after the due date and time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Senior Resident (Radiology)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.D degree or D.N.B or D.M.R.E in Radiology from a recognized University. Candidates holding medical qualifications must also be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council and hold a valid certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BMC Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 38 years for Open category candidates and 43 years for Reserved category candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a BMC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is 6700 + DP 3350/- + D.A. Rs.47637/- + Add. Stipend Rs.27000/-, which totals Rs.84687/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application form fee?
faq.answer: The form costs Rs. 1027/- (Form Fees Rs.870/- + GST 18%). It is paid when buying the form at the Administrative office, D Wing, 1st Floor, between 26 October 2026 and 3 November 2026 (except Saturday and Sunday).

faq.question: Q7. Can I send the BMC Senior Resident application by post?
faq.answer: No. Application forms sent by post will not be considered. The form must be handed in at the Administrative office, Ground Floor, Hinduhridaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Medical College & Dr. R. N. Cooper Municipal General Hospital, Juhu, Mumbai – 400 056.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the counselling for Senior Resident (Radiology)?
faq.answer: Counselling is on 4 November 2026 at 11.00 am onwards, at New College building, 3rd Floor, 5th Lecture Hall. The list of eligible candidates will be displayed on 4 November 2026 after 3.00 pm, and the final list on 5 November 2026 after 3.00 pm.

faq.question: Q9. Is the BMC Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is for a tenure from 6 November 2026 to 31 January 2027. The tenure is likely to be terminated before 31 January 2027 if Bonded/DNB candidates become available.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a security deposit for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must pay Rs.10,000/- by Demand Draft/Pay Order in favour of "BrihanMumbai Municipal Corporation" at joining. The deposit is refunded when the post is completed, subject to recovery of dues. It is forfeited if the candidate leaves before completing the tenure.
